integrity: The exact all-parameter result is derived symbolically; finite matrix exponential tests are independent numerical consistency checks, not an infinite certification.
scientific_limitations: Only simple unweighted finite stars with at least two leaves and the unnormalized generator L+eta L² are proved.
No implication for arbitrary graph structures, weighted edges, resolvent or discrete-time schemes.
No independent scientific or bibliographic validation has been performed.
title: Unique worst positivity delay for Laplacian–bi-Laplacian heat on every star
